Address with privileged rights (owner/root) allowed to recover tokens and set a new root
Mapping address => uint256 tracking amounts already claimed per address
Immutable amount of tokens granted per claim
Public view returning the claimed amount for a given address
Private helper marking an address as claimed by adding claimAmount
Public claim entrypoint that validates caller, marks claimed and transfers tokens
Recovers the whole contract token balance to _root, callable by root via tx.origin or msg.sender

Constructor initializing token, claimAmount and _root (tx.origin)

edges.reason: msg.sender gates execution of Claim via require(msg.sender == tx.origin)
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in Claim to restrict callers to EOAs
msg.sender authorises Recovertokens when equal to _root
tx.origin authorises Recovertokens when equal to _root, enabling phishing-based privilege use
msg.sender must equal _root to execute SetRoot
tx.origin sets the deployer as initial _root in the constructor
Claim calls ClaimedAmount(index) to validate the address has not claimed
Claim invokes the private helper _setClaimed before transferring tokens
Claim performs an external token transfer before emitting the event, enabling reentrancy
Malicious token contract can re-enter Claim during the external transfer call
_setClaimed executes the claimed[index] += claimAmount arithmetic mutation
Claim parameter index flows into claim validation and token transfer
Claim parameter index is passed through to _setClaimed as the mapping key
_setClaimed parameter index keys the claimed mapping write
Arithmetic update writes the incremented value into the claimed mapping
ClaimedAmount parameter index indexes the claimed mapping read
ClaimedAmount reads claimed[index] from state
SetRoot performs the privileged root reassignment write
SetRoot parameter newroot flows into the root reassignment
Local oldroot caches _root prior to the SetRoot mutation
Root reassignment mutates the privileged _root state variable
SetRoot reads _root to enforce msg.sender == _root
Recovertokens reads _root as transfer recipient and authorisation source
Recovertokens performs an external token transfer of the full balance
Token contract can re-enter Recovertokens during the external transfer call
Local allbalance captures balanceOf(address(this)) used as transfer amount
Recovertokens reads the immutable token address to build the ERC20 call
Claim reads the immutable token address for the transfer call
Constructor assigns tokenaddr into state variable token

Constructor assigns claim_by_addr into claimAmount
Constructor parameter claim_by_addr flows into the claimAmount assignment

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter index of ClaimedAmount only serves as the lookup key of the view function and should be merged into function ClaimedAmount
Parameter index of _setClaimed is the mapping key consumed by the arithmetic unsafe operation and should be merged into _setClaimed
Parameter index of Claim is the airdrop recipient passed to _setClaimed and the external transfer, so it collapses into function Claim
Parameter newroot of SetRoot is the value written to _root and should be merged into SetRoot
Constructor parameter tokenaddr is directly assigned to the token state variable inside the constructor
Constructor parameter claim_by_addr is directly assigned to the claimAmount state variable inside the constructor
Local allbalance in Recovertokens is a temporary holding balanceOf result for the external transfer and should be merged into Recovertokens
Local oldroot in SetRoot only caches the previous root before reassignment and should be merged into SetRoot
